Maya R: Follow-up from PM: vendor cascade (cloud IAM throttling -> model-registry 5xx). I created tracker INC-933: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-933. Please claim items and add ETA.

Chris D: I'll own the registry fallback work. Plan: small bounded LRU cache for metadata (TTL=20s) + immutable on-disk snapshot for critical configs. ETA: 2026-02-10.

Arun V: I'll take auth client hardening and alerting. Proposed backoff: exponential with jitter, max_retries=3, circuit breaker on failures=10/window=60s. ETA: 2026-02-07.

pager-bot: Actions created: INC-933-A1 (registry-cache), INC-933-A2 (auth-retries), INC-933-A3 (runbook-update). Owners must update status in 48h.

Maya R: Observations: spikes align with credential rotations and registry flapping. Short-term mitigations: conservative retry budgets, local TTL cache, route to dedicated model-variants on failure, and vendor escalation for IAM limits.

Chris D: Note: cache will exclude signed URLs and secrets. Adding integration test to simulate registry 5xx -> snapshot fallback. PR link will be added to tracker.

Arun V: I'll open vendor support case and paste ticket ID in tracker. Also proposing an alert auth_retry_ratio > 50/min to route to SRE.

Talia N: Security: snapshots must be encrypted with KMS and ACLs; i'll own runbook and KMS rotation updates. ETA: 2026-01-31.

Maya R: Ops rules: set owner rotation for actions >3 days, add "needs-ops-review" tag for cross-team changes, and include vendor contact in tracker. 15m sync tomorrow to confirm ETAs.

Chris D: claimed INC-933-A1, will update tracker now.

Arun V: claimed INC-933-A2, opening vendor case.

Talia N: claimed runbook updates.

Maya R: thanks all — i'll consolidate notes and post a short update to leadership after the sync. :thumbsup:
